description: This file defines a 'Home' UI component for a note-taking application, managing child components, state synchronization with a store, lifecycle methods, and rendering logic with conditional display elements.

classes.name: Home
classes.description: A Lightning.js component representing the main page of the note app with header, notes list, editor, and empty state.

methods.name: mounted
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when the component is mounted, initializes store loading and sets up store subscription.

methods.name: destroyed
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when the component is destroyed, cleans up store subscription.

methods.name: _sync
methods.description: Updates the notes count from store state, handles errors during sync.
